answer.main_body: brain coral in shallow water pool
answer.evidence: The pink brain coral mound is 6 rows tall (rows 8-13) with only a 1-2px highlight along the top edge (rows 8-9) and a vertical front face with shaded crevices, reading as a side elevation rather than having a foreshortened top surface visible from 45 degrees.

answer.main_body: brain coral and shallow water pool

The rounded brain coral mound in shallow water spans rows 8-13, with rows 8-9 forming the illuminated top surface foreshortened from above, transitioning into south-facing shadow in rows 10-13.

answer.main_body: coral mound / cluster in shallow water
